Bad bad service
Mar 2020 • Couples
Unfortunately went here 3 times (as my partner REALLY liked the burgers) and each time got worst. First time service was slow but food was okay. Next time I ordered the same thing and idk if they’d changed chefs but it was horrible - tasted soapy. Final time I ordered vegetarian spring rolls and they came out with big shrimps AND chicken clearly wrapped in them. I get incredibly sick from seafood which I stressed to them and tried to sort out the confusion but they just shrugged and laughed. Poor service. Much better restraints nearby for Vietnamese food that are way cheaper and more authentic. Burger seemed to be the only good thing

Very good restaurant with an extensive menu
Mar 2018 • Solo
As many other vietnames restaurants they have an extensive menu and seems that you usually can get every item on the menu. There are more than 170 different meals. Vietnamese specialities, seafood, pizza, hamburgers etc etc. And breakfast, too.
I have been there many times and always got fresh and well cooked meals. I have for instance had Tuna steak, fried squids, crocodile, claypot, pizza. The frog with lemongrass was of French class and the best I have had in Asia.
And the staff is always friendly and helpful.

Great Lounge for a relaxed evening
Jan 2018 • Friends
The shishas are amongst the best in Nha Trang. Many flavors and tobacco brands available. Good prices. Comfortable seating in an air-con room or an opened rooftop. Nice atmosphere with good (and not too loud!) music. The staff is courteous and efficient. Cocktails are delicious, and so is the food. The menu offers many western choices as well as seafood and vietnamese specialities. All excellent. Recommended.
